study.notes: STUDY: NCT03951753, phase 1 multicentre randomised double blind parallel arm mechanism of action trial (28 weeks) in adults with type 2 diabetes on metformin, BMI 25 to 45, randomised 3:3:2 to tirzepatide 15 mg weekly (maintenance from week 20, dose_mg 15), semaglutide 1 mg weekly (from week 8, dose_mg 1) or placebo, 117 randomised (45, 44, 28); this post hoc exploratory report (Mather 2025) prints Table 1 with baseline and week 28 mean plus or minus SD per arm for HbA1c, triglycerides, leptin and adiponectin with exact p values for the pairwise change comparisons (route arm_change_imputed_r, correlation 0.5; the p values are recorded in the notes, not used); both active arms are entered against the shared placebo arm (rows carry the drug, receptor class, dose and n); biomarkers are exploratory (prespecified FALSE); pct_weight_change from the Table 1 means, tirzepatide 94.2 to 83.4 kg, minus 10.8 kg equals minus 11.5 percent (semaglutide 92.7 to 85.3 kg, minus 8.0 percent; placebo 98.7 to 97.9 kg, minus 0.8 percent; no contrast printed); the primary report (Heise 2023) is the companion; funded by Eli Lilly (industry_funded TRUE); rob_overall low

rows.notes: Table 1: HbA1c percent, tirzepatide 15 mg (N 45) baseline and week 28 vs placebo (N 28); change comparison p below 0.001
Table 1: fasting triglycerides mmol/L, tirzepatide vs placebo; change comparison p 0.0002
Table 1: fasting leptin ng/mL, tirzepatide vs placebo; change comparison p 0.0439
Table 1: fasting adiponectin ug/mL, tirzepatide vs placebo; change comparison p 0.0399
Table 1: HbA1c percent, semaglutide 1 mg (N 44) baseline and week 28 vs placebo (N 28); change comparison p below 0.001; pct_weight_change for this arm minus 8.0 (92.7 to 85.3 kg)
Table 1: fasting triglycerides mmol/L, semaglutide vs placebo; change comparison p 0.0016
Table 1: fasting leptin ng/mL, semaglutide vs placebo; change comparison p 0.0205
Table 1: fasting adiponectin ug/mL, semaglutide vs placebo; change comparison p 0.7700

json.design: phase 1 randomised double blind parallel arm mechanism of action trial, tirzepatide 15 mg vs semaglutide 1 mg vs placebo 3:3:2, type 2 diabetes on metformin, 117 randomised, 28 weeks
json.reason: full text group (institutional route); four inventory markers from Table 1 per active arm against the shared placebo arm by the imputed change route (eight rows)
other_markers: hyperinsulinaemic euglycaemic clamp M value and Matsuda index (insulin sensitivity)
fat mass and fat free mass by DXA

rob.justification: randomised double blind placebo controlled mechanism trial (D1, D2 low); pharmacodynamic analysis set with evaluable data, N as randomised in the table (D3 some concerns); laboratory assays (D4 low); post hoc exploratory biomarker analysis of a registered trial (D5 some concerns)

doubts: the placebo arm is shared by the tirzepatide and semaglutide rows
the primary report (Heise 2023, Diabetes Care) may carry the same Table 1 values; not a separate record of the corpus as far as the pool shows
